name: H&R Century Union Corporation
summary: H&R Century Union Corporation, a company based in Chongqing, China, primarily operates within the entertainment industry. Its main business areas involve the creation of drama series and managing the careers of performing artists across China. The company handles all stages of film and television drama projects, from initial planning and development to production, marketing, and ultimately, distribution. Additionally, H&R Century Union provides asset investment management services. Founded in 1997, the organization was previously known as Stellar Megaunion Corp. before officially adopting its current name in February 2017.
